prompt: Which categories have an average price per unit below 25 euros? Work out each category's price per unit as its total net_revenue_eur divided by its total units, from the sales table and its category_name column. Each total skips missing values on its own, so a line with units but a missing net_revenue_eur still adds its units. Return two columns, in this order: category_name and price_per_unit_eur, that price per unit. Return one row per category, and only the categories whose price per unit is below 25. Do not round. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the group filter: keep only the categories whose total revenue divided by total units is below 25.
Divide the two totals, not each line's own price, and test that division after GROUP BY, repeating it as the SELECT list writes it.
why_this_works: Dividing the category totals weights every unit equally, and HAVING tests that ratio per category; an average of line prices would weight a one-unit line like a ten-unit line.
